newsitem.title: PERU: Peruvian stock exchange to list ADRs and GDRs.
newsitem.headline: Peruvian stock exchange to list ADRs and GDRs.

text.p: Peru's stocks and securities board (CONASEV) said on Tuesday that it authorized the Lima Stock Exchange to list American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) and Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) of Peruvian and other companies.
"The measure has been approved by CONASEV and we are sure it will inject liquidity into the market," said CONASEV general manager Victor Loayza in a statement.
CONASEV sources said the measure would take effect in coming days once it has been published in the official daily El Peruano.
The CONASEV statement added the measure would likely make the local market more susceptible to developments abroad.
